measurement-based optimization can be very useful in the peer-topeer environment, and that a combination of techniques can be used to achieve better performance.

(a) measurement-based techniques can be highly effective in guiding applications to select a high-performance peer; and (b) the basic techniques are complementary and can potentially improve the overall performance.
